comment: Curated stadium -> country map, used only to detect neutral/overseas venues. ESPN's own venue address field is unreliable for internationals (it reports 'Reunion' for the Stade de France and nothing at all for M&T Bank Stadium), so it is never used to infer neutrality. A fixture is treated as neutral when ESPN says so, or when a stadium listed here sits in neither team's country. Ambiguous names (several 'Allianz Stadium's exist) are deliberately omitted rather than guessed.
